# GitHub Copilot Instructions

## Code Quality
- Write clear, maintainable, and well-documented code.
- Follow Java best practices and project conventions.
- Ensure all code changes pass existing tests and do not break the build.
- Use meaningful commit messages.

## Security
- Do not commit secrets, passwords, or sensitive data.
- Validate all inputs and handle exceptions securely.
- Follow secure coding guidelines for Java.

---
For more details, refer to the project README and security policies.
